subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

PIG : MNZ :: ROL : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : ​

 
• First letter ⇒ (3) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter ⇒ (5) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter ⇒ (7) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• PIG : MNZ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7c57c0a991a59ae8ee3217de6e0957bad1fbd03813cb519c323abf5d2c5a940.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ROL :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c1d50ca37cd312aac69ca00b76e545bb0cf3a043bb555b4f6be004dbbcb1ff2.png] ​

Hence, "**OTE**" is the correct answer.
